# Neo.K × EveMissLab

Canonical website: https://thisoneisneok.com/

This is Neo.K's personal site and the public application field of EveMissLab. It contains application showcases, the MSSP field lab, Lean4 formalization entries, a bilingual personal blog, and selected books. It is not the complete paper corpus.
